messages.subject: Re: Problem Rattle/Gtk
parts:
When you start up R, what do you see if you immediately do:

> ls()

It should be pretty empty. If there are rattle variables like crs and
crv, then perhaps delete all objects, exit R saving the R Workspace,
then resart R and try rattle:

> rm(list=ls())
> q()

Does that fix it?

Regards,
Graham
